1951, March 14
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanuo Casey, O.F.l.Cap.
March 14th 1951.
Mrs. J. J. O'Donnell White Wing Hotel Raymondville, Texas.
Fr. Solanus, 0.INC St. Felix Friary, R. R. No. 8, Huntington, Indiana
Bles'd be God in All His designs. God bless you Mrs. O'Donnell - Mirs. Winn .JJ. - you and yours.
I hope you are well and that you may enjoy your exile down there and find it more and more congenial - doing missionary work as long as you can. For, after all every one who believes in Christ Jesus and tries to follow Him is necessarily doing work of a missionary. Glory be to God.
I started to write you before but something so often thwarts me and then its neglected. I talked with Joseph J. a few nights ago and he seemed well - tho somewhat lonely. No doubt you know what that means down there in the great South West.
April 13th Bles'd Be God!
As the inclosed leaflet certificate will indicate, I am enrolling you for God's holy guidance. If it be God's holy will that you sell the Farm we hope that you succeed - as you did a few years back in selling that old house of your Parents. If not; well donot be over anxious about it; but hope that God have other designs.
In the mean time offer up to God your exile etc, in union with that of our dear Lord from Heaven - also that of our Bl'd Mother Mary after the Ascension of Christ and of the Holy Family in Egypt. At all events, we do well to hearken to our dear Lord: "Sufficient for the day is the evil there of." ..... Fr. Solanus, O.F .!!. Cap.
P.S. Tell Joseph J. Many thanks for the elastic bandages received To-day. - in case I neglect it. Fr. S.
